description: This file defines the ViewSupportController class within the OrangeHRM Help plugin. The controller extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up a 'view-support' component for rendering support view in the application.

classes.name: ViewSupportController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for preparing the 'view-support' component for rendering support UI in the OrangeHRM application.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component to be rendered by instantiating a new 'view-support' component and setting it for use in the view.
